claims.disproof_condition: 條件：鼎泰下一份半年報或年報的風險段不再寫新進入者增加；或 PCB 板廠的一手寫出換鑽針供應商需要長的合格期（或相反：隨時可換）。核查頻率：每半年。觸發後 48 小時：重讀鑽針層讀圖的可替代性段。
claims.statement: Guangdong Dtech's own risk disclosure (H1 2026 report): the global PCB drill-bit market is fairly concentrated and competition runs on both price and technology; as downstream demand is released major makers are all expanding capacity; the tool industry has no specific entry barrier and new entrants keep increasing; quality PCB customers usually choose stable, reliable suppliers and are reluctant to switch. Both directions in one disclosure: switching reluctance, but no entry barrier.
